30A Escapes presents… "Ocean Pearl”, your perfect Seacrest escape, located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches. With a spacious main house and cozy carriage house, it’s ideal for your relaxation and fun. Spend mornings at the Lagoon pool moments away, afternoons biking to the beach, and evenings on the rooftop patio enjoying stunning sunsets. Whether it’s a family trip or group getaway, Ocean Pearl is your slice of paradise on 30A. Learn more below…👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Luxury Living: Expansive main house plus a private carriage house, with a spacious layout ensuring everyone has their own private retreat.
✔ Gourmet Kitchen: Chefs in the group will be impressed with the kitchen items that are on hand.
✔ Rooftop Patio: Sunset views, outdoor dining, and a wet bar for evening relaxation.
✔ Steps to the Pool: Just a 2-minute walk to the 12,000 sq ft tropical Lagoon pool.
✔ Prime Location: Walkable to boutique shopping and gourmet dining.
✔ Easy Beach Access: with convenient seasonal tram service right off the door.
✔ 7 Beach Bikes Included: Explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach with ease.

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ "Loved the perfect location near the pool and beach! The carriage house made it ideal for our group." – Kelli R.
⭐ "This house was fully stocked and in a beautiful, safe community. We can’t wait to come back!" – Jessica A.
⭐ "The house was spotless and steps from everything we needed. Best vacation home we’ve stayed in!" – Stacy K.

★☆ LIVING AREAS ☆★

Relax in comfort with stylish, open-concept living spaces designed to bring people together. With plenty of room for group gatherings, these spaces are perfect for hosting friends, spending time with family, or simply unwinding in a modern and inviting atmosphere.

✔ Open-plan living room with cozy, contemporary furniture
✔ Flat-screen TV for entertainment
✔ Additional living area in the private carriage house

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Cook and dine with ease in not one, but two fully-equipped kitchens, complete with modern appliances, ample counter space, and all the essentials you need. Perfect for preparing family meals, hosting dinner parties, or simply enjoying a relaxed cooking experience with friends. These kitchens are designed to make every meal a joy, whether you're whipping up a quick snack or a gourmet feast.

✔ Gourmet kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and wine fridge
✔ Dining table seats 8, bar seating for 5
✔ Carriage house full kitchen with bar seating for 3

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Ocean Pearl features 5 spacious bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, providing ample space for relaxation and privacy. With the ability to comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests, it's the perfect destination for family gatherings, group vacations, or special celebrations.

1st Floor:
✔ Primary Suite: King bed, En-suite bath, Smart TV, direct patio access
✔ Half Bath

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary Suite: King bed, Smart TV, private balcony, and En-suite bath with his and hers sinks, separate water closet and walk-in shower
✔ Twin Guest Room: 2 Twin beds, Smart TV, and access to the balcony
✔ Bunk Room: Twin-over-Full custom bunk bed, Smart TV, with access to the balcony and shared bathroom
✔ Bunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin custom built bunk
✔ Shared Full Bathroom: With double vanity, separate water closet, and walk-in shower

Carriage House:
✔ Bedroom: King bed, En-suite bath with walk-in shower, and flat-screen TV
✔ Bunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin custom built bunk bed

★☆ OUTDOOR AMENITIES ☆★

Ocean Pearl provides the ultimate outdoor luxury with spaces designed for relaxation and entertainment.

✔ Rooftop covered patio, dining space, sunset views and indoor wet bar – Unwind in style with panoramic sunset views, cocktails in hand, and a rooftop dining experience under the open sky.
✔ Large driveway with parking for 4 vehicles – Convenience meets comfort with spacious parking, perfect for hosting family and friends.
✔ 7 adult beach bikes for cruising 30A – Explore the beauty of 30A with ease on our included beach bikes, perfect for scenic rides and coastal adventures.

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Ocean Pearl offers the perfect blend of convenience and vibrant local charm. Nestled just steps away from pristine white sand beaches and boutique shopping, this destination puts everything you need within easy reach.

✔ 2-minute walk to the 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool – A stunning paradise with a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers, plus a poolside café and picnic areas.
✔ Beach Access – Enjoy a seasonal tram for easy transportation or take a short 10-minute stroll to the emerald Gulf waters.
✔ Peddler’s Pavilion – Just a 4-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.
✔ Scenic Walking and Nature Trails – Picturesque paths just steps from the house, ideal for exploration and relaxation.
✔ Walkable, Bike-Friendly Community – Conveniently access beautiful destinations all around.
✔ South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique and stunning natural feature of the area.
✔ Rosemary Beach (8-min walk) and Alys Beach (12-min walk) – Explore charming coastal communities nearby.
✔ Carillon Beach (7-min drive) – More coastal beauty just minutes away.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home. There is also a camera at the corner of the exterior of the home that faces the property.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★

Discover the area's water adventures with swimming nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling.
